label: High at D1 after reaching S1; at GO high after no reward and S2-favoring belief.
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) * (prev_state == S1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * tv("action", -2) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 41; timing (low D1 ~0.3, mid GO ~0.43, saturated D2 ~0.97) explains R^2 0.79. Beyond timing: at D1 it is ~+0.22 higher when the previous trial reached S1 (vs S2), regardless of choice and only weakly of reward. At GO it rises after an unrewarded previous trial (+0.14) and falls with the observer log-odds that S1 is good (higher when S2 is believed good); previous choice a2 and a2->S1 transitions add extra at GO in the free fit. D2 is nearly saturated with a small negative belief_lo dependence. Future reward and the hidden good state add nothing beyond these. The free fit (8 terms, dev 0.61) adds the GO prev_action / a2-S1 interaction and small D1 reward / D2 belief terms; the short form gets 0.57 on dev. Remaining errors concentrate on the first trials of an episode.

issues: The GO claim 'higher after no reward' is too broad. In the residual table GO after a1 S1 u is -0.076 and after a1 S2 u is -0.11, both below average, while after a2 S1 u it is +0.36 and after a2 S2 u +0.23. Misses on the recorded short form show the largest systematic error is exactly this: GO after a1 S1 u is over-predicted by 0.190, and GO after a2 S1 r is under-predicted by 0.139. The no-reward boost really belongs to unrewarded a2 trials.

The previous choice is a main driver at GO (all a1 histories are negative, all a2 histories positive), but the label leaves it out; belief_lo only partly stands in for it. Replacing the GO no-reward term with (prev_action==2)*(prev_reward==0) raises test R^2 beyond timing from 0.557 to 0.584, close to the free fit's 0.593.

D1 'whatever the choice' is only roughly right. After reaching S1, the a2 histories sit higher (+0.22) than the a1 histories (+0.09 to +0.14). With the S1 effect removed, misses still show D1 after a1 S2 over-predicted by about 0.15 and D1 after a2 S2 u by 0.12.

There is a large gap to the observed-only ceiling: the free fit reaches 0.59 and a phase-specific table of the last trial alone reaches 0.69, against 0.81 for all observed cues. So much of the variance tied to history is not captured by any compact form found.
Confirmed: the D1 S1 effect (weight about +0.20), the negative GO belief_lo weight, and that future reward adds nothing (reference 0.00).
